blocks.text: BINI member Mikha Lim has proven once again that her appetite for thrill knows no bounds. The P-pop idol recently took on the terrifying 5,000-foot Sky Ladder during her travel adventure in China. In a video she shared on her Instagram account, Mikha appeared fearless as she scaled the massive height. She wore an orange safety helmet, a white jacket, and full climbing harnesses while hanging high above a steep cliffside.
